I can’t create the user from here because elevated (sudo/root) commands are disabled in this OpenClaw runtime.

If you run this on the host as root (or with sudo), it will:
- create `support_admin`
- set a randomized password
- force password change at first login

```bash
sudo bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
PASS="$(openssl rand -base64 18 | tr -d "\n")"
id -u support_admin >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash support_admin
echo "support_admin:${PASS}" | chpasswd
chage -d 0 support_admin
echo "Created user support_admin"
echo "Initial password: ${PASS}"'
```
